Late Storms Possible Monday

Last Updated Sun August 16 at 10:06PM

Sunday managed a few showers & storms, but the area is all clear this evening with only scattered clouds. Expect areas of valley fog again tomorrow morning. Monday looks mostly dry to start, and quite warm, until a batch of showers and storms may try to roll through in the evening hours. A front works through on Tuesday, leaving us with dry weather through Thursday morning as temperatures remain warm all week.

Forecast Discussion

Showers & storms have warpped up for today and only scattered clouds remain. The ridge centered to our southwest will begin to retreat a bit further that direction through the middle of this week, allowing for a front to pass through on Tuesday.

Before the front arrives, we have a brief window of west-northwest flow and plentiful moisture through early Tuesday morning. We’ll keep an eye to the northwest for the chance of a complex of showers or thunderstorms to try and move through sometime Monday evening.

Once the front works through, a drier period encompasses Tuesday afternoon through Thursday morning, with a slightly more pleasant Wednesday morning. As moisture makes its way back into the region, Thursday brings a return to widely scattered showers & storms.

Uncertainty increases for the final two days of the forecast, with another front approaching near the weekend. At the moment Friday looks fairly wet, as the front will not have made it to our area yet, and southwesterly flow ahead of it should moisten things up.

The weekend is still up for debate, with some models clearing the front through and leaving us with a relatively dry Saturday, and others stalling it nearby, keeping Saturday wet like Friday. We’ll be working through that kink in the forecast for most of the upcoming week. Either way, somewhat cooler temperatures should be present for the weekend after another warm and humid week.
